skill.name: frontend-design
skill.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with strong visual direction, refined details, and working implementation guidance.
skill.summary: Guide polished frontend design with bold aesthetics, responsive layouts, motion, typography, and production quality checks.

security_audit.summary: Static command findings are false positives from markdown code fences, inline code formatting, and frontend CSS/JSX examples. The system-reconnaissance findings are ordinary visual design terms, and no prompt injection, data exfiltration, or malicious intent was found.

static_findings.snippet: Guide creation of distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces that avoid generic "AI slop" aes
- **Organic/Natural**: Earthy tones, fluid shapes, soft shadows
- **Editorial/Magazine**: Bold typography, grid layouts, dynamic composition
- Consider variable fonts for fluid scaling
- Create atmospheric backgrounds instead of solid colors
**Goal**: Create atmosphere and depth, not just solid colors

content.value_statement: Generic generated interfaces often look predictable and weak. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward distinctive, production-ready frontend design.
actual_capabilities: Guides selection of a clear aesthetic direction before implementation.
Covers typography, color, motion, layout, backgrounds, and visual details.
Provides CSS examples for fonts, color variables, animations, and atmospheric backgrounds.
Provides a React hero example using a motion library.
Defines production checks for accessibility, performance, responsiveness, and polish.
limitations: It is guidance only and does not include reusable component files.
It assumes the agent can edit frontend code in the user project.
It does not replace accessibility, performance, or cross-browser testing.
It focuses on visual frontend work, not backend architecture.

use_cases.title: Shape a Product Landing Page
use_cases.description: Create a memorable visual direction for a new product page with stronger typography, color, layout, and motion.

use_cases.title: Upgrade a Plain Component
use_cases.description: Turn a generic frontend component into a polished interface that still meets accessibility and responsive requirements.

use_cases.title: Create a Brand-Fit Interface
use_cases.description: Guide an AI coding agent to build a web page that feels aligned with a specific audience and offer.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for an existing page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use frontend-design to improve this page. Keep the current content, but make the visual direction clearer and more polished.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Component
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a focused UI element.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use frontend-design to create a distinctive component for this feature. Include responsive behavior, accessible states, and refined visual details.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Full View
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a complete product screen.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use frontend-design to build a production-ready app view. Choose a bold aesthetic direction and implement layout, motion, typography, and quality checks.

prompt_templates.title: Audit and Rework UI
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for design critique and implementation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use frontend-design to audit this interface, identify generic choices, then rework it into a distinctive, accessible, and performant frontend experience.

output_examples.input: Design a landing page for a scheduling app.
output_examples.output: A distinctive editorial layout with strong type hierarchy, a focused color system, subtle motion, responsive sections, and accessibility checks.

output_examples.input: Improve a dashboard card that feels generic.
output_examples.output: A refined component direction with clearer spacing, stronger data emphasis, purposeful hover states, and a visual style aligned to the product.

output_examples.input: Create a memorable hero section for a portfolio.
output_examples.output: A bold visual concept with custom typography, layered composition, atmospheric background detail, responsive sizing, and production polish.

best_practices: Define audience, purpose, and constraints before choosing an aesthetic direction.
Use typography, color, motion, and layout as one cohesive system.
Validate accessibility, responsiveness, and performance before delivery.
anti_patterns: Do not reuse generic font and purple gradient combinations by default.
Do not add decorative effects that weaken readability or performance.
Do not deliver static mockups when the request needs working frontend code.

faq.question: Can this skill help build working frontend code?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides the agent toward functional frontend implementation, not only visual mockups.

faq.question: Which AI tools does it support?
faq.answer: It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it only for landing pages?
faq.answer: No. It can guide pages, components, app views, portfolio work, and design-forward interfaces.

faq.question: Does it include bundled assets?
faq.answer: No. It provides design guidance and examples, but it does not include asset libraries.

faq.question: Does it handle accessibility?
faq.answer: It requires WCAG AA awareness and quality checks, but final interfaces still need testing.

faq.question: Why were security findings dismissed?
faq.answer: The flagged patterns were markdown examples and design terms, not executable commands or system probing.
